title: Power-Sizing Simulation Specification for Protocol v1.4.0 Decision Rule B
chronological_note: This specification artifact was committed in commit 259b78f, after the simulation result was already present in commit c481fb3. The timestamp recorded here reflects the wall-clock time of documentation, not a prospective pre-registration freeze. The simulation result is therefore not covered by a prospective registration guarantee. Future studies must commit a frozen specification file prior to executing the simulation to satisfy prospective pre-registration standards.

governance_binding.decision_rule: Decision Rule B (Prespecified N=220, Require Clopper-Pearson LCB >= 90.0%)
governance_binding.cohort_scope: Confirmatory Cohort 3 Sizing Simulation under Declared Scenario Assumptions

calibrated_scenario_assumptions.source_attribution_disclosure: The simulation parameters below are fixed scenario inputs specified for study sizing and power evaluation. They are derived from the synthetic Common Voice 27 development benchmark fixture (reports/stage6m/cv27_development_speaker_benchmarks.csv), not empirically estimated from physical GPU evaluations.

declared_simulation_inputs.baseline_wer_mean_note: Arithmetic mean of the six per-accent baseline WERs hardcoded in simulate_design_stage_joint_power() (paired_cluster_inference.py lines 251-258), matching the synthetic CV27 development fixture means.
declared_simulation_inputs.parameter_rationale: Represents an aspirational development scenario: an average 3.50 pp absolute WER improvement (target_primary_effect_pp = 3.50), a 2.00 pp narrowing of cross-accent disparity (target_disparity_effect_pp = -2.00), with between-speaker standard deviation of 6.50 pp and paired difference standard deviation of 3.20 pp. Under these declared assumptions, N=220 speakers per stratum achieves >=90% lower confidence bound joint power across all 9 hypotheses.

separate_physical_cohort_evidence.context_note: Physical GPU evaluations on NVIDIA Tesla T4 hardware were conducted on Cohort 1 (N=60) and Cohort 2 (N=468) as distinct evidence streams. The power simulation inputs are NOT directly estimated from these physical data.
separate_physical_cohort_evidence.divergence_disclosure: Observed physical WERs (e.g. South Asian 41.38% vs simulated 23.5%, Irish 19.94% vs simulated 26.1%) reflect distinct data distributions. Power results hold strictly conditional on the declared simulation assumptions.

inferential_procedure.study_success_definition: All 9 confirmatory hypotheses rejected simultaneously under Holm-Bonferroni correction.

decision_criteria.enforced_criterion: Exact 95% Lower Confidence Bound (LCB) on estimated joint power must satisfy LCB >= 0.90 (90.0%).

methodological_caveats_and_scope.scope_limitation: This specification documents retrospectively an in silico power-sizing simulation designed to evaluate whether the proposed N=220 sample size has sufficient statistical power under the declared scenario assumptions. It is NOT a physical Cohort 3 experiment or confirmatory evaluation on real audio files.
methodological_caveats_and_scope.prospective_claim_boundary: Study power is conditional on the declared scenario inputs (between-speaker variance of 6.50 pp, paired-difference standard deviation of 3.20 pp, and hypothesized -2.00 pp disparity reduction effect). It is an in silico sizing evaluation under declared assumptions, not an empirical guarantee for physical speech data that may exhibit different variance or effect profiles.
